meta.name: CCNL Lavoro Domestico — DOMINA/FIDALDO/ASSINDATCOLF (conviventi)
signatories: DOMINA — Associazione Nazionale Famiglie Datori di Lavoro Domestico
FIDALDO — Federazione Italiana Datori di Lavoro Domestico
ASSINDATCOLF — Associazione Nazionale dei Datori di Lavoro Domestico

notes.text: SALARY MODEL: conglobated retribuzione globale (TABELLA A — Lavoratori Conviventi, Art. 14 Co.1 lett. a CCNL). Values confirmed from official Domina salary table PDF (TABELLA-minimi-retributivi-2026.pdf, effective 01/01/2026, ISTAT +1.00%). Source is signatory employer association — primary source.

TAX SECTOR: lavoro-domestico (TaxSector.LAVORO_DOMESTICO). Flat per-hour INPS contributions from INPS Circ. 9/2026. A household employer is not a withholding agent: it is not among the sostituti d'imposta of art. 23 c. 1 D.P.R. 600/1973 (art. 33 c. 1 D.Lgs. 33/2025 from 2027), so the engine withholds no IRPEF or surtax and pays no trattamento integrativo, ulteriore detrazione or somma esente.

HOURLY DIVISOR: 234 = 54 x 52 / 12: 54 h/week contractual maximum for conviventi (Art. 14 c. 1 lett. a CCNL 28/10/2025) and monthly pay = hourly pay x weekly hours x 52 / 12 (chiarimento a verbale 1). Convivente and non-convivente are independent pay scales (different tables, different hourly divisors).
ADDITIONAL MONTHS: 13 (tredicesima mensilita, Art. 39 CCNL 28/10/2025). No quattordicesima for domestic workers.

SENIORITY: biennale (24 months), maximum 7 scatti (Art. 37). Per-level amounts = 4% of the retribuzione minima contrattuale of Tabella A; for levels D and D super it includes the indennità di funzione (Art. 34 c. 2 a): 4% x (1,404.51 + 207.69) = 64.49 and 4% x (1,474.73 + 207.69) = 67.30. Amounts frozen at 2026 values: future ISTAT tranches require a manual update.
APPRENTICESHIP: none. Domestic workers are excluded from D.lgs. 81/2015 Art. 47 apprenticeship provisions.

D/DS INDENNITÀ DI FUNZIONE: 207.69 EUR/month (Art. 34 CCNL) for levels D and DS only. Modelled as fixed_allowance (no role restriction — applies to all workers at those levels). Confirmed from Domina official table.

CNEL code H501 confirmed: lavoro-economia.it explicitly lists 'CCNL Lavoro Domestico (Colf e Badanti) [Cnel: H501]'. Also confirmed via kitech.it. CNEL archive verification not attempted (had returned 404 previously).

SINGLE PERIOD 2026-01-01. Pre-2026 tranches out of scope. Post-2026 CCNL 2025-2028 tranches not yet modelled: +30 on BS convivente from Jan 2027, +15 from Jan 2028, +15 from Sep 2028 (other levels proportional — exact amounts require official ASSINDATCOLF/DOMINA table for those periods).

limitation.remediation: Add the 2027 and 2028 tranches from the official ASSINDATCOLF/DOMINA tables.

notes.text: Seniority amounts frozen at 2026 base. Future ISTAT adjustments will raise base_salary but amounts_by_level will need manual update.

limitation.remediation: Update the seniority amounts with each ISTAT adjustment of the minimum tables.

notes.text: Livello Unico (811.09) is a special sub-under-18 level excluded from this model — single-source, limited coverage.

REDUCED HOURS UNDER ART. 14 C. 1: a convivente may agree fewer than 54 weekly hours (art. 14 c. 1: 'con un massimo di [...] 54 ore settimanali'). The CCNL gives Tabella A as monthly values and no rule to proportion them to the agreed hours; the engine scales the pay linearly on the full time the employment states. The art. 14 c. 2 regime (levels C, B, B super up to 30 hours, Tabella B) is the separate file lavoro-domestico-convivente-orario-ridotto.

limitation.remediation: Source how the Tabella A minimum of a convivente with fewer than 54 agreed weekly hours is computed and model it, then remove this note.

notes.text: INPS BAND: the band of up to 24 weekly hours is chosen on the paga oraria effettiva of INPS (circ. 9/2026; INPS page Contributi e agevolazioni fiscali per chi assume un lavoratore domestico): the monthly pay with board and lodging over the hours of the employment (weekly hours x 52 / 12), raised by the tredicesima (x 13 / 12).

limitation.remediation: Validate the hourly INPS bracket lookup for weekly hours up to 24 against the INPS domestic table.

notes.text: BOARD AND LODGING: every level carries the allowance vitto_alloggio, the valore convenzionale of board and lodging provided in kind (Art. 36 c. 3, Tabella F 2026: 2,33 + 2,33 + 2,00 per day, x 30 = 199,80 per month). A regular run pays no cash for it and counts it in the TFR base (Art. 41 c. 1); the tredicesima pays it in cash (Art. 39 c. 1, chiarimento a verbale 5). It is not reduced for reduced hours (Art. 14 c. 2: intera retribuzione in natura).
CAS.SA.COLF: contributi di assistenza contrattuale of Art. 54 c. 2, 0,06 EUR per paid hour, 0,02 withheld from the worker and 0,04 paid by the employer, charged on the contributable hours of the run.

The cash indennita sostitutiva of board and lodging is not paid for the days the convivente does not take them: ferie (Art. 17 c. 7), sospensioni extraferiali (Art. 18 c. 1), congedo matrimoniale (Art. 24 c. 2), malattia and infortunio outside hospital (Art. 27 c. 9, Art. 29 c. 7). The request carries no fact on whether board and lodging were taken, so the engine pays none.

limitation.remediation: Add a fact for the days without board and lodging and pay the Tabella F value for them.

notes.text: The INPS contributions of the tredicesima are paid on the hours of the year: INPS bands them on the paga oraria effettiva, which spreads the tredicesima over the hours, so the tredicesima run charges no INPS hours. The Cas.Sa.Colf contribution of Art. 54 c. 2 is charged on the contributable hours the run states, a tredicesima run too: no bundled source says whether the tredicesima carries hours of its own for it.

limitation.remediation: Source from the Cas.Sa.Colf rules whether the tredicesima carries contributable hours and set them for extra-month runs.

notes.text: SICKNESS (Art. 27): INPS pays no indemnity to domestic workers; the employer pays 50% of the retribuzione globale di fatto up to the third day and 100% from the fourth, for at most 8, 10 or 15 days in the 365 days that end on the sick day, within a comporto of 10, 45 or 180 days, for up to 6 months of seniority, up to 2 years and over 2 years. A sick day is a thirtieth of the monthly pay (chiarimento a verbale 2).
Art. 27 c. 6: the comporto is 50% longer for an oncological illness certified by the ASL. The request does not say whether an episode is oncological, so the engine keeps the ordinary comporto.

limitation.remediation: Add a fact for an oncological sickness episode and lengthen its comporto by 50%.

notes.text: Art. 27 c. 9: the conventional value of board and lodging is part of the sick pay only when the worker is not in hospital or in the employer's home. The request does not say where the worker is, so the engine pays the monthly pay as stated.

limitation.remediation: Add a fact for the days in hospital or in the employer's home and leave the board and lodging out of their sick pay.

notes.text: NIGHT WORK (Art. 14 c. 6): ordinary work between 22.00 and 6.00 is paid with a 20% supplement of the hourly retribuzione globale di fatto; the engine takes its amount as a NightShiftEvent stated by the caller. The overtime bands are those of Art. 15 c. 3 (25% by day, 50% by night, 60% on a holiday or Sunday); night overtime on a holiday has no band of its own and a run that states it is rejected.

ANNUAL MINIMI: the minimi of the CCNL are updated every year from 1 January by the Commissione nazionale (Art. 38, ISTAT variation of the consumer prices); the bundle holds the table of 2026. From 1 January 2027 the amounts are those of 2026 until the 2027 table is published and added, so a 2027 run is not payable.

limitation.remediation: Add the minimi of 2027 set by the Commissione nazionale with their source, then remove this note.

provenance.transformation: INPS pays domestic workers no sickness indemnity, so the employer pays the CCNL rate: 50% up to the third consecutive day (the carenza) and 100% from the fourth, for at most 8, 10 or 15 days and within a comporto of 10, 45 or 180 days, for up to 6 months of seniority, from 6 months to 2 years and over 2 years (bands from 0, 6 and 24 months). Readings: 'nell'anno' of c. 7 is taken as the period of 365 days of c. 5, and the 365 days 'decorrenti dall'evento' as the year that ends on the sick day; a day past the paid days is unpaid; the daily pay is a thirtieth of the monthly pay (chiarimento a verbale 2: 'giorni di calendario' are thirtieths, 'esempio: malattia').

reviews.scope: Whole file. The values checked were not recorded.
findings: The review recorded no list of the documents it read.

reviews.scope: Every payable rule of the file: minimums, hourly divisor, additional months, seniority, Cas.Sa.Colf, overtime, absences, leave and the accrual of the tredicesima, read in the signed text of 28 October 2025 and its 2026 table (p. 59); the sickness rule of Art. 27 stays derived (readings in its transformation).
findings: Overtime: the file held 10% and 20%; Art. 15 c. 3 sets 25% by day, 50% by night and 60% on a holiday or Sunday. The 20% of Art. 14 c. 6 is the supplement of ordinary night work, not of overtime.
accrual_rule was missing: chiarimento a verbale 4 counts a fraction of a month of at least 15 calendar days as a whole month.
Citations moved from the DOMINA table and section labels without page to the signed text with page and quote.

Seniority of levels D and D super: the file held 4% of the minimum without the indennità di funzione (56.18, 58.99); Art. 34 c. 2 a) makes the indennità part of the retribuzione minima contrattuale on which Art. 37 c. 1 computes the 4%: 64.49 and 67.30.
Tabella A, the indennità di funzione and Tabella F match the signed table (p. 59) and the DOMINA table of 2026.

reviews.scope: Limitation hourly_inps_bracket_unvalidated: the band of the hourly INPS contribution up to 24 weekly hours against the worked quarters of a signatory of the CCNL (DOMINA) and INPS circ. 9/2026.
findings: INPS circ. 9/2026 downloaded again on 2026-10-16: same sha256 as the bundle, no rectification in the text; the 2026 amounts of the file stand.

DOMINA states that the paga oraria effettiva includes the hourly share of the tredicesima and prints four quarters of 2026 (13 weeks): colf 10 h at 8.00 an hour, 1.70, 221.00 (worker 55.90); colf 10 h at 9.00, 1.92 because 9 x 13 / 12 = 9.75 is above 9.61, 249.60 (62.40); colf 25 h, 1.24, 403.00 (100.75); badante convivente 54 h, 1.24, 870.48 (217.62). The engine's effective pay and band match all four (tests/knowledge/ccnl_engine/contribution/domestic/services/test_effective_hourly_pay.py::test_the_band_of_the_published_quarters_of_a_signatory): the raise by 13/12 is validated.

Still unvalidated, so the limitation stays: the share of board and lodging in the effective pay of a convivente up to 24 weekly hours. DOMINA states it ('per chi ha vitto e alloggio, il loro valore convenzionale'), as the engine computes it, but prints no worked case with board and lodging, and no worked example of a convivente up to 24 hours was found.
